title: Pantry Bot — Chat Usage
description: A single view of which bot features are actually being used: a per-feature usage/status table, built-in and custom command activity, Twitch event intake, engagement actions, and bot replies.

panels.title: Built-in commands completed (7d)
panels.description: Successful canonical command completions during the available part of the rolling 7-day window. Collection began with the Oracle worker metrics rollout; until 7 days have elapsed, zero means no recorded successes since rollout, not no earlier use. Aliases count under the canonical name.

panels.title: Enabled custom commands never used
panels.description: Lifetime count from PostgreSQL. This is durable across bot restarts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE enabled AND use_count = 0) AS "unused_enabled" FROM custom_commands

panels.title: Feature usage — what's actually being used
panels.description: One row per Twitch/community feature this bot tracks in PostgreSQL. Status is derived from how long ago each feature last recorded anything: Active = within 7 days, Dormant = within 30 days, Stale = older than that, Never used = zero rows ever. A feature reading Dormant or Stale is not a dashboard bug -- it genuinely has not fired recently. Built-in/custom commands have their own per-command tables below instead, since 'last used' isn't tracked per command the same way.

targets.rawSql: SELECT feature AS "Feature", status AS "Status", last_used AS "Last used", count_7d AS "Last 7d", count_30d AS "Last 30d" FROM (SELECT feature, last_used, count_7d, count_30d, CASE WHEN last_used IS NULL THEN 'Never used' WHEN last_used > now() - interval '7 days' THEN 'Active' WHEN last_used > now() - interval '30 days' THEN 'Dormant' ELSE 'Stale' END AS status FROM (SELECT 'Chat/system engagement actions' AS feature, max(to_timestamp(at/1000.0)) AS last_used, count(*) FILTER (WHERE to_timestamp(at/1000.0) > now() - interval '7 days') AS count_7d, count(*) FILTER (WHERE to_timestamp(at/1000.0) > now() - interval '30 days') AS count_30d FROM engagement_actions UNION ALL SELECT 'Community game actions', max(to_timestamp(at/1000.0)), count(*) FILTER (WHERE to_timestamp(at/1000.0) > now() - interval '7 days'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE to_timestamp(at/1000.0) > now() - interval '30 days') FROM community_actions UNION ALL SELECT 'Twitch event intake', max(created_at), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days') FROM pantry_events UNION ALL SELECT 'Bot replies', max(day)::timestamptz, sum(count) FILTER (WHERE day > (now() - interval '7 days')::date), sum(count) FILTER (WHERE day > (now() - interval '30 days')::date) FROM engagement_message_counts) f) x ORDER BY last_used DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Built-in command usage — last 7 days
panels.description: Every registered built-in command is exported, including zero-use commands. Collection began with the Oracle worker metrics rollout, so the 7-day window is partial until 7 days have elapsed. Counts aggregate across PantryBot replicas; Prometheus handles counter resets. Aliases count under the canonical name.

panels.title: Custom command inventory — lifetime uses
panels.description: PostgreSQL use_count is cumulative for custom commands. Zero means no successful use has been recorded since creation. Disabled commands remain listed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "command", enabled, category, permission_level, source, use_count AS "lifetime uses", created_at AS "created" FROM custom_commands ORDER BY enabled DESC, use_count ASC, name

panels.title: How to read this dashboard
panels.description: What is counted and what is not collected.

options.content:
**Feature usage table above:** each row is one PostgreSQL-tracked feature. Status comes from how long ago it last recorded anything -- Active (within 7 days), Dormant (within 30 days), Stale (older), Never used (zero rows ever). This is the fastest way to tell "broken" from "just not used": a broken query shows a red warning icon on the panel itself, not a Dormant/Stale row. "Chat/system engagement actions" covers both chat-triggered and bot/system-triggered engagement, since source='chat' alone has never had any rows.

**Built-in commands:** successful completions over the rolling 7 days, from Prometheus. Collection began with the Oracle worker metrics rollout, so the window is partial until 7 days have elapsed. A zero during this period means no successes recorded since collection started, not no earlier use. Every registered command appears at zero; Prometheus handles counter resets. Aliases count under the canonical command. Data older than Prometheus retention is unavailable.

**Custom commands:** lifetime successful uses from PostgreSQL. This count survives bot restarts. Enabled commands with zero uses are surfaced above; disabled commands remain in the inventory.

**Not measured:** ordinary chat text, unrecognized !commands, and failed/cooldown command attempts are not retained as command usage. A blank table or zero count means no data was collected for it; it does not by itself prove the feature is unused -- check the feature table's Status column for that.
